scores.round_files_fidelity_rationale: Unchanged at 6.3. Good: for REAL32 params paramfile::save now reproduces ConfigRawParams.BUT_save_Click -> SaveParamFile exactly: cell = float G7 in the current culture, double.Parse, then SaveParamFile's own double.Parse(ToString()) and invariant G15, so 0.135f is written as '0.135' in both '.' and ',' cultures. on_event matches only the type the planner asked for, so Resume Mission and the connect-time rally fetch leave the planner alone, as C# does. setWPParams runs at the C# point in processToScreen (after the rows, before the Reset Home prompt, skipped by the empty-list early return), in C# order with last-wins. The context Save WP File now goes through savewaypoints as saveWPFileToolStripMenuItem_Click -> SaveFile_Click does. The UTM test's expected point is built from the parsed cell texts, as convertFromUTM reads them. Lost: (a) MAVLinkParam.ToString() prints Value.ToString() (double G15) for every non-REAL32 type, but save() has no ptype and formats every value as float G7, so an INT32 such as INS_ACC2_ID = 33426954 is saved as 33426950; (b) N2 is approximated by (v*100).round()/100 on the binary double, which differs from .NET Framework's 15-digit-then-round (WPNAV_RADIUS 100.5 gives 1.01 in C# and 1.00 here), rounds metres rather than the displayed unit value (multiplierdist), and the loiter box's Enabled state is not modelled; (c) the requester tag lives in the view, not on the link request, so loadwpsonconnect, which in C# is the planner's own BUT_read_Click, was cut off. A read that times out still emits an empty MissionDownloaded, which now matches awaiting_read and clears the grid, where C#'s getWPs throws and leaves Commands alone. A disconnect mid-read leaves a stale tag that a later Resume Mission download will match; (d) setWPParams is not run from FlightPlanner.Activate (FlightPlanner.cs:322). None of the four changes is covered by a new test.

compile_check.summary: Checked every changed region against its definitions. paramfile.rs: save's item is (&String, f32); dotnet::float_to_string(f32) -> String (dotnet/mod.rs:679), double_parse(&str) -> Result<f64, Exception> (1475), and double_to_string(f64) -> String (669) passed by path to Result::map gives Result<String, Exception>. double_parse(&cell)'s borrow ends at the call (Result<f64, Exception> borrows nothing), so unwrap_or(cell) can move cell. The list is Vec<(String, String)>, as ParamFile::save_text(&[(String, String)]) expects (extlibs/utilities/paramfile.rs:94). The roundtrip test still infers BTreeMap<String, f32>. flight_plan.rs: awaiting_read: Option<u8> is declared (170) and initialised in Default (247). In on_event, 'match e' on &LinkEvent binds mt: &u8 through 'mt @ (0 | 1 | 2)' under default binding mode, and LinkEvent::MissionDownloaded.mission_type is u8 (link.rs:182), so 'self.awaiting_read == Some(*mt)' compares Option<u8> with Option<u8>. The guard only borrows self immutably, and the arm body's mutation is fine because e is not borrowed from self. mission_io assigns Some(mission_type: u8) before the early return; the spawned closure still captures mission_type by copy. The setWPParams block: params is BTreeMap<String, f32>, so get(&str) works through Borrow<str>; n2 is a non-capturing |f64| -> f64 closure; wprad infers Option<f64>; 'r as f32' and '*v' (f32) assign to Settings.wp_radius/loiter_radius: f32 (app.rs:42-43); or_else returns Option<&f32>. menu.rs: savewaypoints(&mut self, &mut AppCtx) is pub(super) in views::flight_plan. menu is a child module (flight_plan.rs:16), so it was reachable even when private. The call sits in the same menu_button closure that already calls self.read_qgc110wpfile(&text, true, app), so the captures are unchanged. The removed direct write may leave platform::save_text or mission imports used elsewhere (menu.rs:267, 676-677), so at most warnings remain. UTM test: format_fixed(f64, usize, u32, &CultureInfo) with current_culture() -> &CultureInfo; back(String) -> f64; utm_signed_to_geo(i32, f64, f64) -> Option<(f64, f64)> (coords.rs:77) unwrapped. No definite compile error was found.

findings.summary: R63-04 is partly fixed: processToScreen now runs a setWPParams block in the C# place and order, and the context Save WP File calls savewaypoints. The setWPParams port is imprecise. (1) N2 is (v*100).round()/100 on the binary double. .NET Framework takes 15 significant digits first and then rounds half away from zero, so WPNAV_RADIUS = 100.5 gives '1.01' in C# (G15 '1.00500000000000') and 1.00 here (1.005*100 is 100.49999999999999 in binary). dotnet::format_fixed already implements the right rule. (2) C# rounds the displayed-unit value (v * multiplierdist) and divides it back on use; Rust rounds metres, which differs under feet. (3) TXT_loiterrad.Enabled = false when neither LOITER_RADIUS nor WP_LOITER_RAD exists is not modelled. (4) setWPParams is not called from FlightPlanner.Activate (FlightPlanner.cs:322), so opening Flight Plan after a param download does not refresh the radii. The other R63-04 items are unchanged: no ZoomAndCenterMarkers after processToScreen/LoadWPFile; load_text sets 'Loaded <name>' even when read_mission_json fails (flight_plan.rs:1582), and wpfilename is set only in the WPL branch; the Load WP File filter omits .shp/.kml (menu.rs:561); load_list keeps WaypointFile plus a home-made .fen fallback; errors are toasts. savewaypoints passes only the file name of wpfilename where C# sets fd.FileName = wpfilename.
findings.required_fix: Implement setWPParams as its own function: format with format_fixed(v * multiplierdist, 1, 2, culture) plus N2 grouping, store the text, and parse it where C# parses TXT_WPRad. Then do the remaining R62-04 items 3-8 (ZoomAndCenterMarkers, lbl_wpfile on a JSON failure, filters, .fen/rally loaders, modal message boxes).

verdict: A narrow fix round with no definite compile errors. One finding is fully fixed (R63-10: the UTM test now parses the same cell texts) and three are partly fixed. REAL32 parameters are now saved as Mission Planner saves them. The planner only applies downloads it asked for. processToScreen loads the WP and loiter radii. The context Save WP File goes through savewaypoints. Each partial fix again leaves a C# divergence. Integer parameters of 1e7 or more are saved with 7 significant digits. The view-side read tag cut loadwpsonconnect off from the planner entirely. A read timeout still clears the grid. The Geo-Fence/Rally context Downloads now fill lists C# discards. The N2 rounding differs from .NET at decimal midpoints, ignores the distance unit, and is not run from Activate. Nothing new is tested. No owned files were ported, so progress stays at about 5.5% (26,127 / 479,014) and the cap stays 1.6. Awarded 1.3; round-file fidelity 6.3; UI/UX 2.2; features 3.1.
